lines.text: Leo planned his hike around the shortest day of the year.
Across much of the US, the earliest sunsets come in early December, about two weeks before the solstice.
He was still on the ridge at four thirty when the light went.
The wind picked up, his face went numb.
Now he packs three things: a charged headlamp, a neck gaiter for the wind, and a winter plan.
Save this before your next afternoon hike.
